free_tier.stated: 20 GB free at signup, plus stacking achievements of 5 GB each (desktop app, mobile app, per invite, VPN trial, Pass trial) valid 365 days

egress.terms: Not metered per GB, but free/non-account downloads are throttled by a transfer quota computed on your IP over the past six hours. Paid users are metered per account instead and can grant a slice of their quota to link downloaders (25% default).

tooling: Native rclone backend 'mega' (Tier 2, v1.41+); official MEGAcmd CLI; MEGA S4 (S3-compatible) is the paid object store.
chaining: 20 GB + N x 5 GB achievements per account, x unlimited free accounts. Achievement bonuses are per-account and do NOT compound within one account beyond one of each, so the multiplication is accounts, not achievements.

limits.value: invite, VPN trial, Pass trial) valid 365 days Transfer quota is per-IP over 6 h on fre

limits_note: Achievements expire after 365 days. Zero-knowledge encryption means every client re-encrypts.
reliability_note: Does not lose data; throttles hard per IP and per link. Accounts with no login for ~3 months are at risk of quota cuts.
